subject.title: Move native locale artifact regeneration to a post-merge workflow (control-ui-locale-refresh pattern)

question: Should native locale artifacts move to a serialized post-merge generated-files workflow, with contributor PRs limited to English source and deterministic inventory updates?
rationale: This changes the repository’s ownership, review, CI, and recovery model for native translations; the correct permissions, merge gating, and generated-PR policy require maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor a bounded workflow design
options.body: Adopt the existing Control UI ownership pattern after documenting serialized execution, generated-PR permissions, retry behavior, and the post-merge parity gate.

options.title: Retain PR-time regeneration
options.body: Keep generated locale artifacts in contributor PRs and address conflict friction only through narrower tooling or documentation improvements.

options.title: Prototype behind maintainer review
options.body: Create a small workflow prototype and evaluate its permissions and release-gate behavior before making it the canonical writer.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a bounded workflow design
recommendation.body: Adopt the existing Control UI ownership pattern after documenting serialized execution, generated-PR permissions, retry behavior, and the post-merge parity gate.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposal is grounded in recent merged native-app work that this contributor authored and observed firsthand.
